title: Yellow Glazed Venezuelan Pork Empanadas
description: Charred, gooey empanadas filled with slow-cooked pork and topped with a sweet and tangy Venezuelan-inspired glaze, featuring Italian seasoning and a hint of smokiness from the bonito flakes.
instructions: In a large skillet, cook the pork shoulder over medium heat until browned on all sides
Add the Italian seasoning and bonito flakes to the skillet and stir to combine
Transfer the pork to a slow cooker and cook on low for 8 hours or high for 4 hours
In a large bowl, combine the cornmeal, sugar, and water to form a dough
Knead the dough for 5 minutes until smooth and elastic
On a lightly floured surface, roll out the dough to a thickness of 1/4 inch
Cut out circles of dough using a cookie cutter or the rim of a glass
Place a tablespoon of the slow-cooked pork in the center of each dough circle
Fold the dough over the filling to form a half-moon shape and press the edges to seal
Brush the tops of the empanadas with the beaten eggs for a golden glaze
Bake the empanadas for 15-20 minutes or until golden brown
Cook pork to an internal temperature of 63°C / 145°F and let it rest for 3 minutes before serving.
